Your event.
The format that fits.

Every proposal considers the venue, guest count, duration and menu. Costs, inclusions and each party’s responsibilities are agreed beforehand.

Open bar+

The organiser covers the service within an agreed menu, duration and terms. Guests enjoy the included drinks without paying per order.

On-site sales+

Guests pay for their drinks. Feasibility, prices and operating costs are agreed with the organiser and venue.

Mixed format+

Organisers can offer selected drinks, an open-bar period or an allowance per guest. Other orders are paid for by guests, with clear terms from the outset.

Need a team to run the bar at your event?+

We also operate temporary bar spaces at events. We coordinate the team, offer, operation and commercial terms with the organiser, according to the venue and event size.

What is agreed in the proposal?+

A good experience starts with a clear proposal. These points are defined before the service is confirmed.

Drinks & menu

Cocktails, gins, alcohol-free options and other included drinks; quantities or consumption terms.

Team & timings

Team size, service duration, preparation and terms for any extension.

Venue & materials

Existing bar or agreed solution, drinkware, ice, equipment, access and site requirements.

Costs & responsibilities

Price, travel, payment for drinks and what Cheers, the venue and the organiser each provide.

PRACTICAL QUESTIONS

Plan with
confidence.

I already have a venue and caterer. Can I book just the bar?+

Yes. We can integrate bar service into the existing setup, coordinating with the people responsible. We confirm venue requirements and what each party provides before finalising the proposal.

What determines the quote?+

Location, date, guest count, duration, menu and the resources needed. Tell us whether you prefer an open bar, on-site sales or a mixed format so we can prepare an appropriate proposal.

What if the venue does not have a bar?+

We assess the service area, access and required resources with you. The solution and its feasibility are confirmed in the proposal; every venue has its own requirements.

Can guests pay for some of their drinks?+

Yes. A mixed format lets you cover selected drinks, an open-bar period or an allowance per guest. Guests pay for other orders under terms agreed in advance.

Can we personalise cocktails and include alcohol-free options?+

Yes. We can develop recipes and adapt names, flavours and presentation to your wedding or company concept. The menu can include classics, low-alcohol and alcohol-free drinks, with personalisation agreed in the proposal.

When should I get in touch?+

As soon as you have a date or period in mind. We check availability and travel to your location. Booking and confirmation terms are agreed in the proposal.
